basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Texas, majoring in Computer Science. I recently got into gaming and have been exploring various titles, with Modern Warfare being my current favorite. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends. I work part-time at a local electronics store and am currently single. I'm also interested in technology and often find myself browsing subreddits related to computer viruses and oddities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in gaming and technology, primarily self-taught through online forums and YouTube videos. My knowledge is expanding as I engage more with communities and learn from other users.
